주사위 5개를 굴려 나온 눈으로 아래 칸 중 하나에 점수를 적는다. 에이: Roll 5 dice and, using the faces that come up, write a score in one of the boxes below. Ones (1)·Twos (2)·Threes (3)·Fours (4)·Fives (5)·Sixes (6): the sum of the faces of the dice showing that face. Choice: the sum of the five faces. Four of a Kind: if there are 4 or more of the same face, the sum of the five faces, otherwise 0 points. Full House: if it is made up of 3 of one face and 2 of another face, the sum of the five faces, otherwise 0 points (if all five are the same, it is not a Full House). Small Straight: if all four faces of one of 1-2-3-4, 2-3-4-5, 3-4-5-6 are present, 15 points, otherwise 0 points. Large Straight: if the five faces are 1-2-3-4-5 or 2-3-4-5-6, 30 points, otherwise 0 points. Yacht: if all five are the same, 50 points, otherwise 0 points.
